verdict.headline: Pipedrive offers free developer sandboxes for immediate local testing, but public distribution requires a formal marketplace review that can take up to 21 business days.
verdict.timeToFirstConnection: 15–30 minutes to create a free sandbox account, register an app in Developer Hub, and complete the OAuth exchange locally.
verdict.timeToProduction: Same day if using private apps via direct install links; up to 21 business days if publishing a public app on the Marketplace due to review times.
verdict.handsOnEffort: 2–4 hours for app setup, token handling with tenant routing, demo video creation, and submission documentation.
verdict.cost: Free ($0 listing and onboarding fees; Pipedrive takes a 20% commission on Marketplace-billed paid apps).
verdict.biggestRisk: API routing failures caused by neglecting dynamic tenant `api_domain` endpoints, or app rejections due to unverified scopes and incomplete review demo videos.

ownAppDecision.summary: You must register your own OAuth app with Pipedrive because Composio uses a 'bring your own OAuth app' model for this integration.
reasons: Composio does not provide shared credentials for Pipedrive; you must input your own Client ID and Client Secret.
Access tokens in Pipedrive are tied to tenant-specific base URLs (`api_domain`) that must be routed per connected customer.
Custom scopes (such as `admin` or `leads:full`) must be explicitly declared and configured in your own Developer Hub app registration.

phases.name: Account & Environment Preparation
phases.goal: Obtain a free developer sandbox and review the required API scopes.

steps.title: Create Developer Sandbox Account
steps.detail: Sign up for a free sandbox account at developers.pipedrive.com using your email and first name. No paid subscription is required.

steps.title: Define Scopes and App Type
steps.detail: Decide whether your integration will be a Private app (internal company use or direct link) or a Public app (Marketplace listing). Select minimal scopes needed for your agent.
steps.agentHelp: Audit required API endpoints against documented Pipedrive scopes (e.g., base, contacts:read, leads:full).

phases.name: App Registration & OAuth Implementation
phases.goal: Register your client in Developer Hub, capture tokens, and correctly route API requests to tenant subdomains.

steps.title: Register App in Developer Hub
steps.detail: Open Developer Hub within your Pipedrive sandbox, register a new app, configure your exact OAuth callback URL, and obtain your client_id and client_secret.
steps.agentHelp: Validate redirect URI structure and check for exact URL matches.

steps.title: Implement Authorization Redirect
steps.detail: Direct users to https://oauth.pipedrive.com/oauth/authorize with client_id, redirect_uri, and an optional state parameter.
steps.agentHelp: Generate authorization URL construction helper and CSRF state generator.

steps.title: Implement Token Exchange and Basic Auth
steps.detail: Exchange authorization_code at POST https://oauth.pipedrive.com/oauth/token within 5 minutes. The request must use an HTTP Basic Auth header encoded with client_id:client_secret.
steps.agentHelp: Generate token exchange client code including HTTP Basic header encoding and form body parameters.

steps.title: Persist Tenant Domain and Tokens
steps.detail: Save the returned api_domain (e.g., https://company.pipedrive.com) alongside access_token and refresh_token. Ensure the database field for access_token is at least varchar(768).
steps.agentHelp: Generate database migrations with varchar(768) columns and write tenant-aware HTTP client wrappers.

phases.name: Marketplace Review or Direct Distribution
phases.goal: Submit materials for public Marketplace review or distribute via direct private installation link.

steps.title: Compile Listing Materials
steps.detail: Provide a published Privacy Policy URL, Terms of Service URL, short summary (<=150 characters), app name, and 1 to 5 listing images.
steps.agentHelp: Draft app description, feature summaries, and privacy policy sections covering Pipedrive data usage.

steps.title: Record Scope Demo Video and Provide Test Accounts
steps.detail: Create a 1–3 minute video clearly demonstrating every requested scope in action. Set up functional credentials for the Pipedrive review team.
steps.agentHelp: Draft demo video script detailing step-by-step demonstrations of every requested OAuth scope.

steps.title: Submit for App Approval
steps.detail: Agree to the Developer Partner Agreement and submit your app via Developer Hub. Await review results (can take up to 21 business days).

phases.name: Token & App Maintenance
phases.goal: Prevent token expiration and maintain compliance with API rate limits.

steps.title: Maintain 60-Day Refresh Rotation
steps.detail: Execute refresh token exchanges before the 60-day inactivity cutoff to prevent customer sessions from invalidating permanently.
steps.agentHelp: Automate proactive token refreshing background jobs running at scheduled intervals.

steps.title: Handle Per-Tenant Rate Limits and API Updates
steps.detail: Monitor API usage against per-company token-bucket limits and ensure developer contact info remains active for deprecation notices.
steps.agentHelp: Implement retry logic with backoff for rate-limited requests and audit for API version changelogs.

requirements.detail: Free account obtained at developers.pipedrive.com to create apps in Developer Hub and access test data.
The redirect_uri passed in both authorize and token endpoints must strictly match the URL registered in Developer Hub.
Live public links detailing data gathering, management, and terms of service are mandatory for public Marketplace approval.
A 1–3 minute video demonstrating usage of all requested scopes and working test credentials for Pipedrive reviewers.
Must be reviewed and agreed to prior to submitting a public app for marketplace listing.

permissions.name: base
permissions.purpose: Read authorized user profile, basic settings, currencies, and user connections.
permissions.notes: Automatically granted to all OAuth apps upon authorization.

permissions.name: contacts:read
permissions.purpose: Query persons, organizations, notes, files, and filters for CRM contextual awareness.
permissions.notes: Read-only access to contact and company records.

permissions.name: users:read
permissions.purpose: Verify user identities, roles, and administrative permissions before executing privileged actions.
permissions.notes: Useful to inspect user permission sets via GET /users/{id}/permissions.

permissions.name: recents:read
permissions.purpose: Track recent changes and account activities to synchronize CRM updates with the AI agent.
permissions.notes: Read access to the account changelog.

permissions.name: search:read
permissions.purpose: Search items across the customer's Pipedrive account via agent search queries.

permissions.name: leads:read
permissions.purpose: View CRM leads, lead sources, and lead labels.
permissions.notes: Read-only access dedicated specifically to leads data.

permissions.name: leads:full
permissions.purpose: Create, modify, label, and delete CRM leads autonomously.
permissions.notes: Allows full CRUD operations (GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE) on leads.

permissions.name: admin
permissions.purpose: Configure custom fields, pipelines, stages, activity types, and manage webhooks.
permissions.notes: Required to manage app webhooks. If installed by a non-admin, admin-level endpoints will fail at runtime.

nuances.title: Dynamic Multi-Tenant API Base URLs
nuances.detail: Pipedrive does not use a single static API host for authenticated REST calls. The OAuth token response returns an `api_domain` property (e.g., https://company.pipedrive.com) that must be stored and used as the base path for all subsequent API calls for that user.

nuances.title: Token Column Length Requirement
nuances.detail: Pipedrive access tokens contain variable-length encrypted payloads. Database columns allocated for access tokens must be sized to at least `varchar(768)` to avoid silent string truncation.

nuances.title: 60-Day Inactive Refresh Token Expiry
nuances.detail: While access tokens expire in 1 hour (3599 seconds), refresh tokens expire permanently if left unused for 60 consecutive days, forcing the user to complete the installation flow from scratch.

nuances.title: Non-Admin Installation of Admin Scope Apps
nuances.detail: The marketplace consent screen does not block non-admin users from installing an app that requires the `admin` scope. If a non-admin installs it, administrative endpoints fail; apps must inspect `GET /users/{id}/permissions` to detect limited users.

nuances.title: All-or-Nothing Scope Consent
nuances.detail: Pipedrive does not permit partial or selective scope approvals. End users must either accept all requested scopes in one screen or decline the installation entirely.

blockers.symptom: OAuth authorization or token exchange call fails immediately with an invalid redirect URI error.
blockers.howToProceed: Ensure the redirect_uri query string in GET /oauth/authorize and the form parameter in POST /oauth/token match the exact string registered in Developer Hub character-for-character.

blockers.symptom: POST to https://oauth.pipedrive.com/oauth/token fails with 401 Unauthorized or invalid client errors.
blockers.howToProceed: Pass client_id and client_secret formatted as HTTP Basic Auth header: `Authorization: Basic base64(client_id:client_secret)` during the token POST.

blockers.blocker: Scope Failure Due to Non-Admin Installer
blockers.symptom: Admin-scoped endpoints return forbidden/permission error codes even though the app was authorized.
blockers.howToProceed: Query `GET /users/{id}/permissions` using the granted token upon installation. If the authorizing user lacks administrative privileges, prompt them to have an account administrator reinstall or reauthorize the app.

agentCan: Generate OAuth redirect URLs, token exchange request handlers, and HTTP Basic authentication headers.
Write database models and migrations allocating `varchar(768)` for token storage and persisting the dynamic `api_domain`.
Implement token refresh scheduling logic to avoid the 60-day expiry window.
Draft required Marketplace submission copy, including scope justifications and demo video scripts.
youMust: Sign up for the Pipedrive Sandbox Account at developers.pipedrive.com.
Register the app within the Pipedrive Developer Hub and input redirect URIs.
Record and host the 1–3 minute scope justification demo video.
Create and publish public Privacy Policy and Terms of Service URLs.

drafts.title: Marketplace Scope Justification Notes
drafts.purpose: Explain to Pipedrive reviewers why each requested OAuth scope is required by your application.
drafts.content:
Dear Pipedrive App Review Team,

Our integration, [APP_NAME], provides AI-assisted workflow automation for CRM teams. Below is the justification for our requested OAuth scopes:

1. `base`: Required to authenticate the active user, detect the user's currency settings, and associate incoming activities via `/users/me`.
2. `contacts:read`: Used by our AI assistant to retrieve relevant person and organization context when summarizing customer history.
3. `leads:read` and `leads:full`: Required to let users draft, qualify, and update new leads directly from automated inbound channels.
4. `admin`: Necessary for our integration to register and manage webhook subscriptions for real-time lead updates.

We have provided functional test credentials and demonstrated each scope in our attached review video. Let us know if you require any additional information.

drafts.title: Review Demo Video Script
drafts.purpose: Step-by-step recording guide to demonstrate required scopes within 1–3 minutes.
drafts.content:
[0:00-0:30] Introduction: Show [APP_NAME] landing page, click 'Connect to Pipedrive', and show the OAuth consent dialog displaying all requested scopes (`base`, `contacts:read`, `leads:full`, `admin`).

[0:30-1:00] Data Access Demo: Accept consent and show the app retrieving contact details (`contacts:read`) and recent CRM activity into the AI assistant interface.

[1:00-1:45] Action & Mutation Demo: Trigger an AI action that creates a new lead in Pipedrive (`leads:full`). Switch tabs to the Pipedrive sandbox UI to verify the lead and custom activity appeared immediately.

[1:45-2:15] Webhook / Admin Demo: Show the webhook registered via the `admin` scope firing in response to an update. Conclude by demonstrating token disconnect/revocation.

drafts.title: Non-Admin Privilege Warning Prompt
drafts.purpose: UI notification shown when a user without administrative permissions authorizes an app requesting admin privileges.
drafts.content:
Notice: Pipedrive Administrator Permission Required

Hi [USER_NAME], you have successfully connected your Pipedrive account, but your user profile does not have administrative rights in [COMPANY_NAME].

Because [APP_NAME] synchronizes automated webhooks and pipeline settings (which requires the `admin` scope), some automated features will remain disabled.

Please ask a Pipedrive account administrator to reauthorize [APP_NAME] via this link: [INSTALL_LINK].
